messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look at the **federal long weekends** in Canada for 2023.  
(If a holiday falls on a Monday or Friday, the adjacent weekend days create a “long weekend.” If it falls on a weekend, the holiday is usually observed on a weekday, but the weekend itself is already a long weekend.)

| Holiday | 2023 Date | Observed (if different) | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-----------|--------------------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sun) | Jan 2 (Mon) | Dec 31 (Sat) – Jan 2 (Mon) |
| Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, etc.) | Feb 20 (Mon) | — | Feb 18 (Sat) – Feb 20 (Mon) |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Fri) | — | Apr 7 (Fri) – Apr 9 (Sun) |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Mon) | — | May 20 (Sat) – May 22 (Mon) |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Sat) | Jul 3 (Mon) | Jul 1 (Sat) – Jul 3 (Mon) |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Mon) | — | Sep 2 (Sat) – Sep 4 (Mon) |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 (Mon) | — | Oct 7 (Sat) – Oct 9 (Mon) |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Wed) | Nov 10 (Tue) | — (no long weekend) |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Mon) | — | Dec 23 (Sat) – Dec 25 (Mon) |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 (Tue) | — | — (no long weekend) |

> **Note:** Some provinces have additional holidays that create their own long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.). If you need province‑specific data, let me know!
